# SPIKE (Phase 0, 0.0.6). Field meanings: the header of the vanilla common/bypass/00_bypasses.txt.
# Generated by hand from one template (Phase 1: a generator or inline_script).
#
# Entry points are 1:1 (decided 2026-11-03): one scripted-connection type per pair. node = the
# regular system (flag ahw_entry_open_N, set when repaired), nexus = the ring system holding that
# pair's exit (flag ahw_exit_N). A type with one node and one nexus connects exactly those two.
# Runs 4-5: changes reach route-finding on the next daily tick; the country needs the tech,
# add_seen_bypass_type and set_visited on the ring.
# windup_time = 10 (as the hyper relay): ended the detours Sol -> ring -> neighbour (run 6).
# extends_sensors = yes (as vanilla wormholes): Q: does an entry point show its exit's label and
# menu without a ship in the ring system (run 6: only under sensor coverage)?

ahw_spike_entry_1 = {
	name = AHW_SPIKE_ENTRY
	is_pathfind = yes
	uses_action = no
	requires_exploration = no
	always_active = yes
	windup_time = 10
	winddown_time = 0
	ftl_multiplier = 0
	extends_sensors = yes
	icon_frame = 25
	remember_instances = no
	animation_time = 1
	galactic_map_tooltip_header = AHW_SPIKE_ENTRY
	galactic_map_tooltip_desc = AHW_SPIKE_ENTRY_DESC
	connection_type = scripted_connection
	ftl_ship_effect = "gateway_ftl_ship_effect_entity"
	ftl_bypass_effect = "gateway_ftl_bypass_effect_entity"
	can_bypass_be_locked = yes

	scripted_connection = {
		node = { has_star_flag = ahw_entry_open_1 }
		nexus = { has_star_flag = ahw_exit_1 }
	}

	prerequisites = {
		ahw_tech_spike
	}
}

# Shortcut ring_1 <-> ring_4. Run 5: as a natural wormhole it set off vanilla's first-wormhole
# story (apoc.5); now a megastructure pair on its own scripted connection, no tech needed.
ahw_spike_shortcut_1 = {
	name = AHW_SPIKE_SHORTCUT
	is_pathfind = yes
	uses_action = no
	requires_exploration = no
	always_active = yes
	windup_time = 0
	winddown_time = 0
	ftl_multiplier = 0
	extends_sensors = yes
	icon_frame = 12
	remember_instances = no
	animation_time = 1
	galactic_map_tooltip_header = AHW_SPIKE_SHORTCUT
	galactic_map_tooltip_desc = AHW_SPIKE_SHORTCUT_DESC
	connection_type = scripted_connection
	ftl_ship_effect = "wormhole_ftl_ship_effect_entity"
	ftl_bypass_effect = "wormhole_ftl_bypass_effect_entity"
	can_bypass_be_locked = no

	scripted_connection = {
		node = { has_star_flag = ahw_shortcut_1_node }
		nexus = { has_star_flag = ahw_shortcut_1_nexus }
	}
}
